title: Nov 2 UC Rusal worker demonstration at Kirkvine, Manchester
exclusion_reason: Report supports an executed demonstration and more than 120 affected workers, but the wage/fringe-benefit dispute is directed at private employer UC Rusal. The article states the Ministry of Labour scheduled mediation but does not report a demand directed at domestic state policy; eligibility target is not established. Do not pool workers across Manchester and St Ann for site threshold.

occurrence.value: Observer reports a Nov 2 work stoppage and demonstration outside the Kirkvine head office.

threshold.value: More than 120 employees reported overall; no separate demonstration headcount is stated.

target.value: Wage/fringe benefit negotiations with company; ministry meeting was scheduled, but no state-policy demand is reported.
